methods.description: Round factors to convenient values, multiply and compare the reported product with its rough size.
Keep the one-digit divisor and choose a nearby compatible dividend, then compare quotient sizes.
Use the estimate to detect answers about ten times too large/small or select a plausible candidate.
Compare positive original factors with smaller convenient factors and require product above that benchmark.
Distinguish plausible size from exact correctness and reject impossible quotient/remainder reports.
